mapper.insert: insert into user(openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values(#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as new_count FROM user WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE(create_time)) as total_count FROM user WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
